prompts.walk:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the attached transparent HERO WALK sprite sheet. Keep exactly this character identity, clothing, small head, slim 3.5-4-head-tall body, painterly detail, warm upper-left light and cool shadows, 40-degree overhead camera. Silver-gray hair, crimson scarf, navy tunic with cream cuffs and hem, brown leather gloves and boots. No swords.
Make a coherent 6-frame WALK loop in each row. EXACTLY 18 separate full-body figures, 3 rows x 6 columns, evenly spaced with completely transparent gutters. Row1 faces directly toward the bottom of the screen, row2 directly toward the top (back view), row3 faces right. All three rows must have equal standing body height and equal head size.
CRITICAL: Fix the very weak leg alternation. Col1 shows right foot clearly stepping FORWARD and left foot clearly behind. Col2 transitions with right foot planted and left foot passing. Col3 is upright neutral feet-nearby STANDING (this is also game's idle frame). Col4 has the OPPOSITE contact: LEFT foot clearly FORWARD and right foot clearly behind. Col5 transitions with left planted and right passing. Col6 returns through a near-neutral passing posture to col1. Front/back walking needs clear knee bends and distinct boots with a visible 25-35px front-back separation at 280px character height; do not duplicate same foot forward in all columns. Arms swing opposite the legs. Subtle 2-4px torso rise, no crouch/running lean. Keep the torso upright.
The anatomical RIGHT hand in every pose is a closed brown-gloved gripping FIST, a readable small circular fist center, no weapon. Left hand naturally relaxed/gloved. Scarf moves minimally, no changing costume, no huge head, no outlines heavier than the reference.
Preserve requested original canvas 1672x941 if possible; no cropped limbs, no overlapping figures, no text or numbers, no ground shadows, no background. True alpha transparency.

prompts.walk-stride-refinement:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production RPG walk-cycle sprites. The input is ONLY the character identity/painting reference, not an animation pose template. Build a NEW complete gait sheet.
Same silver-gray-haired slim young hero, crimson scarf, navy tunic with cream cuffs and hem, brown gloves and boots, small head, 3.5–4 heads tall, warm upper-left light/cool shadow, fine hand-painted edges. 40-degree overhead camera, upright torso. No sword, right hand clenched into a clear glove fist in EVERY pose.
EXACTLY 18 figures in 3 rows x 6 columns. Row1 faces SOUTH toward viewer; row2 NORTH fully away; row3 EAST side view.
The columns MUST be a genuine alternating walking sequence, not repeated static steps:
1) LONG CONTACT A: anatomical RIGHT leg well forward, LEFT leg well back; LEFT arm forward, RIGHT arm back.
2) PASSING A: weight on right leg, bent left knee passes right leg; right fist moving forward.
3) NEUTRAL: upright relaxed STANDING feet side-by-side, both arms near sides. This frame is used for idle.
4) LONG CONTACT B: anatomical LEFT leg well forward, RIGHT leg well back; RIGHT fist forward, LEFT arm back. THIS MUST BE VISIBLY OPPOSITE TO COLUMN1.
5) PASSING B: weight on left leg, bent right knee passing; right fist moving back.
6) NEAR-NEUTRAL RETURN with slightly raised heel, so it loops to1.
For FRONT and BACK views separate forward/back boots by at least a clearly visible boot LENGTH vertically, widen the stride, bend knees and articulate the hips. Both boots must remain visible, no static parallel legs. At approximately280px body height use at least35px depth difference between boot tips in contact frames1and4. In side view the leg visible on the near side must switch from forward in1 to BACK in4.
Keep head size, anatomical proportions and costume exactly consistent across18 figures. Subtle2-4px gait rise, not exaggerated running or squatting. Equal scale in every row. True transparent background and broad transparent gutters; no shadows, ground, grid, captions, letters or numbers. Wide sheet 1800x1000 preferred, fit full bodies with margin.
